messages.text: IF-011. POST /api/companies/:id/questionnaire (body {}) answers 200 { fileId, fileName, directory, sentAt (ISO), message }; 404 company_not_found; 500 write_failed (its message already says 'Nada foi alterado.'). POST /api/companies/:id/questionnaire-answers takes { content: string (the text of the .fitpulse file), replaceDraft?: boolean } and answers 201 { draftId, clientSavedAt (ISO) }. Errors (ApiError.details holds the extra keys): 409 draft_exists { draftCreatedAt (ISO) } -> open the 'Substituir o rascunho de {data}?' modal and repeat with replaceDraft: true; 422 answers_other_company { fileCompanyName, currentCompanyName } (message already 'Este arquivo é de X, não de Y.'); 422 answers_newer_version, answers_incompatible, answers_invalid ('Este arquivo não é um arquivo de respostas do FitPulse.'); 413 payload_too_large (file over 1 MB; same message when the 2 MB body parser stops it); 400 validation_failed when content is missing. The server message of the import refusals does NOT include 'Nada foi alterado.' nor 'Escolher outro arquivo': the dialog adds both. 'Mostrar na pasta' = POST /api/files/:fileId/reveal with the fileId of the send.

Table questionnaire_sends (model QuestionnaireSend: id, companyId, fileName, sentAt, answeredAt, clientSavedAt, draftId; draftId has NO foreign key; cascade from companies). 'aguardando' = answeredAt IS NULL. Use createQuestionnaireRepository(prisma) from server/repositories/questionnaireRepository.ts: listAwaiting(companyId?) returns the sends still waiting, newest first; findClientSavedAtByDraft(draftId) returns Date | null for the timeline mark 'Respostas do cliente, salvas em {data}' (null for a draft that was not imported). An import marks ALL waiting sends of the company answered; with none waiting it inserts a row (fileName 'respostas-{empresa}.fitpulse', sentAt = answeredAt = import time) so every imported draft has its mark. For bulk reads, query questionnaireSend.draftId from your own repository code instead of one call per draft.

diagnosisRepository gained importDraft(companyId, values, { replace, afterCreate(tx, record) }) returning company_not_found | draft_exists { draftCreatedAt } | imported { record }: one transaction, and it replaces ALL drafts of the company when replace is true. A draft created by import is a normal draft (currentBlock 1, no diary marks). questionnaireService keeps clientSavedAt at or before the import time (a client clock set ahead is clamped).

Backup and restore (IF-009, server/services/backupService.ts and backupSchemas.ts) do not carry questionnaire_sends, so a restored backup forgets which companies were waiting for answers (nothing else breaks: an import with no waiting send records itself). Decide in Phase 7 whether the backup should include them; this unit did not touch the backup files.
